json.role: standard-library JSON parsing and syntax validation

jsonschema.role: JSON Schema validation for qualification outputs

geopandas.role: future vector GIS processing and CRS-aware tables

shapely.role: future geometry operations for contains, nearest, and distance checks

pyproj.role: future CRS transforms and coordinate validation

osmnx.role: future controlled OSM pedestrian network preparation

requiredForBuildingMatching: GDAL/Fiona/pyogrio stack if source formats require it

installPolicy.requirementsUpdatePolicy: Update data_pipeline/requirements.txt only in a dedicated dependency milestone after version review.
installPolicy.networkPolicy: Do not run OSMnx network downloads or package installation in P5-B2.
installPolicy.versionPolicy: Document and pin or record versions before real GIS processing.

risks: Windows GIS package compatibility can be fragile.
Fiona/GDAL installation may require a different IO backend or carefully selected binary packages.
OSMnx can trigger network downloads and cache writes if not controlled.
OSM license and attribution requirements must be reviewed before route outputs are used.
Package version drift can affect geometry, CRS, and file IO behavior.
nextActions: P5-B3 should create or verify a project-local Python GIS environment.
P5-B3 should decide whether to update data_pipeline/requirements.txt.
P5-B3 should rerun JSON Schema validation and pytest once jsonschema and pytest are available.
Real source ingestion should wait until dependency versions and install policy are documented.
